page.overview:
What is Amry?

Amry was a coastal settlement found along the eastern stretch of the Dragon Coast, in the greater Eastern Heartlands of central Faerûn. It was located just north of the Gulthmere Forest, some ways west of Telpir.

The settlement of Amry was governed by a local council.

Along with the nearby settlement of Telpir, Amry enjoyed a good trading relationship with the Fellowship of the Purple Staff.

As of the , Amry was regularly imperiled by the bands of pirates that operated in the Sea of Fallen Stars.
